title: Stopglue
summary: Stopglue is a spell that creates a stream of a sticky, glue-like substance. As such, this spell can be used to render enemies or objects immobile without actually causing damage.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
This spell was discovered by Cherit on a scroll in the secret laboratory under Klaus' bookshop. After Dante Vale read this scroll, Dante used Stopglue to imprison unnamed Suit 027's Enforcer and unnamed Suit 028's Bonelasher. Shortly after, the spell was used to impede Klaus' Brahe and then to secure a bookcase to block the team's escape. [The Bookshop Hunter]

Inside the Hamelin Cathedral, upon getting swarmed my Gremlow's special ability, Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill and Den Fears decide to leave the cathedral to think of a solution to defeat the Titan. To stop the massive flow of Gremlow copies from breaking open the door, Sophie used Stopglue to seal the entrance. [Gremlow Infestation!]

Dante used the spell on Grand Façade's feet while fighting Wilder inside Hermán Cortés' vault. This allowed Caliban to strike Grand Façade's unprotected back, sending the Titan back to his amulet. [The Power of Umbra]

Several Stopglue spells were cast by both Sophie and Dante as part of an elaborate trap to neutralize the Casterwill Hunters guarding the entrance to the Phoenix Volcano. Den also hid the Stopglue spells with Hidesight so the trap wouldn't be spotted. Four Casterwill Hunters ended up getting stuck on the glue-like substance. Noticing the Soldiers were freeing themselves from the trap, Den and Sophie used several Augerfrost spells to harden the glue. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

Dante used Stopglue in conjunction with Bristlebind to immobilize Hoffman while fighting with him on the The Professor's Castle. [An Ally from the Organization]

sections.heading: International Names
sections.text:
Dutch: Lijmvast
Portuguese: Cola-trava, Cola Paralisante
